rv.q: That they achieve what they do is a testament to their extraordinary abilities and their obvious love for terpsichore.
It is fantastically executed and is not to be missed.
Their commitment, precision, and sheer joy in movement carry the evening through its less defined stretches.
Dancing and choreography are both just beautiful.

cn.t: This high-energy dance revue showcasing iconic Broadway choreography delivers top-flight dancing and full orchestral accompaniment, though vocals don't quite match the impressive terpsichorean skills on display.

vr.q: If you love Broadway dance, and I mean really love it, there's no reason not to see this show. It is a masterclass in what choreography can do when it's in service of storytelling.
